app-templates.message:
docs(arc42): the explainer keeps a fixed size per component, its figure an implementation detail

## Intent

Dropping the size limit applies to interactive apps only. Text-heavy explainer pages must load fast, so each component keeps a fixed size. The figure itself is an implementation detail of the build check.

## Key changes

- A new explainer decision sets a fixed size per component, without naming the figure.
- The generic frame limits no app's size; an archetype may limit its own parts.
- Only the size budget of the interactive runtime stays recorded as technical debt.
- The evidence file records the decision.
